decks.name: LeetCode #230 - Kth Smallest Element in a BST
decks.description: Find the kth smallest value in a binary search tree

cards.question: Kth Smallest Element in a BST: Given the root of a binary search tree, and an integer k, return the kth smallest value (1-indexed) of all the values of the nodes in the tree.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Traverse entire tree collecting all node values into array using any traversal order. Sort the array, then return element at index k-1. Simple but inefficient with O(n log n) time due to sorting. Doesn't leverage BST property that inorder traversal visits nodes in sorted order.

solutions.name: Inorder Traversal
solutions.explanation: Use inorder traversal (left, root, right) which visits BST nodes in ascending order. Collect all values in array during traversal, then return k-1 index. Leverages BST property for sorted order without explicit sorting. O(n) time but still visits all nodes even after finding kth element.

solutions.name: Recursive DFS (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Optimized inorder traversal that stops early after finding kth element. Use counter starting at k, decrement on each node visit during inorder traversal. When counter reaches 0, store result and return immediately. Avoids processing remaining nodes. Best case O(k) time when kth element is found early.

solutions.name: Iterative DFS (Optimal)

solutions.name: Morris Traversal
solutions.explanation: Inorder traversal without stack or recursion using threading technique. Temporarily modify tree to create links from predecessor to current node, traverse, then restore original structure. When no left child, process node. When left child exists, find predecessor, create thread or follow thread. Achieves O(1) space complexity. Most space-efficient solution.
